fusions.name: Squall Front
fusions.desc: A wall of falling water deals 14 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, knocks each back 2 tiles and has a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped from Height
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 30 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and also 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Cupped Palms
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Grey Spell Breaks
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
